name: Rings Wipe
description: Concentric rings ripple out from the center and, one after another, each sweeps around like a clock hand in the opposite direction of its neighbors to reveal the second clip, or fills across its width, with optional colored borders between the rings. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of rings, from the center to the farthest corner

params.name: center
params.description: Center of the rings (0..1, y down)

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between the starts of two rings: 0 moves them all together, 1 starts each one when the previous one is done

params.name: radial
params.description: Each ring fills across its width, outward and inward in turn, instead of sweeping around

params.name: border_width
params.description: Width of the borders between the rings while they move, in frame heights (0 disables them)

params.name: border_color
params.description: Color of the borders between the rings
